sentences.text: Shri Govind Rai Purohit - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Harish Singh Rathore - G.A. for respondent No.1/Stat
ORDER 1] They are heard and perused the case diary.

2] This is the applicant's third bail application filed under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023/ Section 439 of Cr.P.C. as he is implicated in connection with Crime No.270/2021 registered at Police Station Sanwer, District- Indore (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 363, 366 & 376(3) of IPC and Sections 3/4 of POCSO Act.
The applicant is in custody since 11.06.2021.
His earlier bail applications have been dismissed as withdrawn.
3] The allegation against the applicant is of abduction and rape.

4] Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the prosecutrix was a consenting party, which is also apparent from her police statement as also the statement given before the Magistrate, however, under the pressure of her family members, she has also given a false statement before the Magistrate that she was subjected to gang rape, whereas the charge-sheet has been filed only against one person the present applicant.

Counsel has also drawn the attention of this Court to the discrepancies in the statement in which the prosecutrix, on one hand, has clearly given a clean chit to the applicant that he has not done anything wrong, and on the other, she has made NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-IND:3266 2 MCRC-1188-2026 allegations against as many as three persons, and the fact that charge-sheet has been filed only against one person.
Thus, it is prayed that the application be allowed.

Rahul Kharadi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 2 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157115275/
1 5] Counsel for the State has opposed the prayer.
6] Having considered the rival submissions, perusal of the case-diary and the statements of the prosecutrix, under the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court finds force in the submissions as advanced by the counsel for the applicant, and is inclined to allow the present application.
7] Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application filed by the applicant is hereby allowed.

sentences.text: The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his/her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he / she shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.

If the applicant is found to be involved in violation of any of the terms of this order, an application for cancellation of his bail may be filed before the trial Court itself, who shall decide the same, in accordance with law.
8] Accordingly, the application is allowed and disposed of.

(SUBODH ABHYANKAR) JUDGE Pankaj Rahul Kharadi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 2 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157115275/
